Always on/Carousel/Day in my Life.title: Timestamped day in my life
Always on/Carousel/Day in my Life.description: A cover promises a timestamped day as a graphic designer, then each slide is a candid moment with a clock time and a casual caption. Brands can hand this to staff or creators to show the people behind the work.

Always on/Carousel/Dont open.title: Don't open this
Always on/Carousel/Dont open.description: Torn-paper slides keep warning people to stop ("This is your last warning", "Still here? Wow.") until the reveal lands on the product. Reverse psychology works for any launch or new range drop.

Always on/Carousel/Everything for the we.title: Everything for the week
Always on/Carousel/Everything for the we.description: A photo dump of creators in branded merch, mixed with short cut-out video edits where the product and gear float around them. Works for any brand drop or activation recap that needs to feel fun and creator-made.

Always on/Carousel/Follow the number.title: Pick a number
Always on/Carousel/Follow the number.description: "If you're looking for a sign, pick a number" with numbered lines that run across the slides, each one leading to a different product and the need it solves. Good for brands with a range people struggle to choose from.

Always on/Carousel/Keep Scrolling.title: Keep scrolling sandwich
Always on/Carousel/Keep Scrolling.description: "Keep scrolling" sits next to the edge of a slice of bread, and the sandwich keeps going across every slide. Any long product (a sub, a sausage, a scarf) can stretch the carousel for a silly payoff.

Always on/Carousel/Open this.title: Open this envelope
Always on/Carousel/Open this.description: A red envelope shows a new pun-filled note on every slide ("Client Crush", "Be Our Clientine") before the logo signs off. Easy Valentine's or occasion post for any brand with a few good wordplay lines.

Always on/Carousel/Recharge Battery.title: Recharge my battery
Always on/Carousel/Recharge Battery.description: "Time to recharge my battery" sits over an empty battery that fills up with travel items one at a time. Fill it with whatever your audience needs to recharge, like snacks, a holiday or the product.

Always on/Carousel/Seamless Carousel.png.title: Seamless monthly recap
Always on/Carousel/Seamless Carousel.png.description: One long panorama sliced into slides, with shapes and photos crossing the cuts so every swipe flows into the next. Good template for a monthly recap or wins post told as one continuous strip.

Always on/Carousel/Seamless Occasion.title: Hobby ideas, scrapbook style
Always on/Carousel/Seamless Occasion.description: Each slide is one activity idea (reading, sketch, picnic) with a big pink word, a one-line tip and polaroid inserts. A brand can turn it into weekend or occasion ideas with their product sitting in the scene.

Always on/Carousel/Slide to open.title: Slide to open
Always on/Carousel/Slide to open.description: Cupped hands hide something with "Guess what's hiding behind these hands?" and the swipe opens them to reveal the product. Any pack shot or new launch can sit behind the hands.

Always on/Carousel/There will be signs.title: Signs you can't ignore
Always on/Carousel/There will be signs.description: The product's shape shows up somewhere unexpected on every slide, a cloud, an ice cube, with the same line "the signs you can't ignore". Works for brands with an iconic shape or logo people will spot instantly.

Always on/Carousel/This Close.title: You're this close
Always on/Carousel/This Close.description: Opens on a pinching hand with "You're this close to..." then zooms in slide by slide until the tiny text between the fingers is readable. Good for any brand line you want people to physically lean in for.

Always on/Carousel/Weekday deals loading.title: Weekday deals loading
Always on/Carousel/Weekday deals loading.description: A loading bar fills up with products slide by slide, so people swipe to see it hit 100%. Swap in this week's specials or a snack bundle and let the full bar be the deal.

Always on/Carousel/Yes but Trend.title: Yes, but... trend
Always on/Carousel/Yes but Trend.description: Each slide splits into a dreamy "yes" photo on top and the messy reality "but" underneath, like a cake and then the pile of dishes. Brands can play the honest flip side of their category for an easy relatable laugh.

Always on/Reels/ASMR/ssstik.io_@askinem_.title: Fruit platter fill-up
Always on/Reels/ASMR/ssstik.io_@askinem_.description: Top-down ASMR of a sectioned serving tray being unboxed and filled one fruit at a time, ending with the dip. Satisfying format for any product that gets filled, stocked or styled.

Always on/Reels/ASMR/v1c044g50000d6acscf.title: Craving fix fruit bowl
Always on/Reels/ASMR/v1c044g50000d6acscf.description: Hands-only build of a fruit salad from a single bowl, with crunchy chopping and tossing sounds doing the work. Works for quick healthy recipes or 'what I eat' content.

Always on/Reels/Aesthetic/Bag in differe.title: Same bag, different places
Always on/Reels/Aesthetic/Bag in differe.description: One branded bag sits locked off in a gym, park and court while life moves around it. Shows a product fits every part of the day without saying it.

Always on/Reels/Aesthetic/Girl Grip.mp4.title: The job title grip
Always on/Reels/Aesthetic/Girl Grip.mp4.description: An arm holds out a handful of everyday items that sum up a 'social media manager grip'. Swap in any role, customer type or product range for a quick relatable post.

Always on/Reels/Aesthetic/Let me wipe th.title: Wipe-the-lens food reveal
Always on/Reels/Aesthetic/Let me wipe th.description: 'Wait, let me wipe the camera', a hand wipes the lens and an empty table is suddenly full of food. Simple in-camera transition that works for any menu or product spread.

Always on/Reels/Aesthetic/MAKE IT COLD B.title: Cold brew pour macro
Always on/Reels/Aesthetic/MAKE IT COLD B.description: Slow, moody pours over ice shot as macro close-ups and a split-frame. Good template for any drink launch that wants a premium feel.

Always on/Reels/Aesthetic/ReactNativeBlo.title: App-switcher scroll edit
Always on/Reels/Aesthetic/ReactNativeBlo.description: The video moves through the phone's app switcher, landing on a food shot and a hypnotic spiral. Native phone UI framing that feels like the viewer's own screen.

Always on/Reels/Aesthetic/ReactNativeBlo.title: Brick catch match cut
Always on/Reels/Aesthetic/ReactNativeBlo.description: Hands toss a brick across guide lines and match cut into a wall being built. Smooth handover edit for building, trade or process stories.

Always on/Reels/Aesthetic/ReactNativeBlo.title: Giant everyday objects
Always on/Reels/Aesthetic/ReactNativeBlo.description: A creator holds an oversized ice cream and stands next to a giant pigeon in the street. Big-scale CGI that turns a product into a scroll stopper.

Always on/Reels/Aesthetic/ReactNativeBlo.title: Supermarket speed run
Always on/Reels/Aesthetic/ReactNativeBlo.description: Fast POV dash through a store from cleaning machine to trolley to price signs. High-energy retail walkthrough for specials and store tours.

Always on/Reels/Aesthetic/ReactNativeBlo.title: Doodle-to-dish table fill
Always on/Reels/Aesthetic/ReactNativeBlo.description: Scribbled drawings appear on an empty table then turn into real dishes. Playful order build for cafes and restaurants.

Always on/Reels/Aesthetic/ReactNativeBlo.title: Split-panel mood edit
Always on/Reels/Aesthetic/ReactNativeBlo.description: Multiple framed panels play at once as she listens, scrolls and snacks. Film-look grid layout that makes a simple moment feel editorial.

Always on/Reels/Aesthetic/ReactNativeBlo.title: Coffee and a song
Always on/Reels/Aesthetic/ReactNativeBlo.description: Top-down iced coffee with a music player overlay and big serif lyrics. Calm, moody format pairing a product with a track.

Always on/Reels/Aesthetic/ReactNativeBlo.title: Lift doors outfit change
Always on/Reels/Aesthetic/ReactNativeBlo.description: A lift opens on one bold outfit, the camera whips up through the shaft, and the doors open on a completely different look. Good teaser format for a style or range launch.

Always on/Reels/Aesthetic/ReactNativeBlo.title: Hungry to full slider
Always on/Reels/Aesthetic/ReactNativeBlo.description: A hand drags a dip lid between 'full' and 'hungry' and the table changes with it. Interactive-feeling joke for food brands with combos.

Always on/Reels/Aesthetic/ReactNativeBlo.title: New burger walkout
Always on/Reels/Aesthetic/ReactNativeBlo.description: A waitress walks out the door with the new burger and fries, with bold type naming each item. Simple launch format for a new menu item.

Always on/Reels/Aesthetic/ReactNativeBlo.title: Emoji recipe build
Always on/Reels/Aesthetic/ReactNativeBlo.description: A cursor clicks each emoji and the drink builds layer by layer, ending on the logo. Playful drink or recipe reveal with zero words.

Always on/Reels/Animals/ReactNativeBlobU.title: Pet nature documentary
Always on/Reels/Animals/ReactNativeBlobU.description: A house cat gets the wildlife-doc treatment, with serious subtitles narrating its 'hunt' that ends at the food bowl. Easy win for any pet or food brand.

Always on/Reels/Clothing/ReactNativeBlob.title: Summer kit silhouettes
Always on/Reels/Clothing/ReactNativeBlob.description: Items pop in and out of blue silhouettes to build a summer packing list. Works for fashion or accessories showing a full kit.

Always on/Reels/Clothing/ReactNativeBlob.title: Above-the-head outfit tutorial
Always on/Reels/Clothing/ReactNativeBlob.description: Step by step CapCut tutorial for the overhead phone-hold outfit shot. Teaches a trend, which makes it easy to save and share.

Always on/Reels/Clothing/ReactNativeBlob.title: Shirt colour swap on a tree
Always on/Reels/Clothing/ReactNativeBlob.description: A shirt hangs on a tree and props appear as the colourway keeps changing. Locked-off stop motion for showing range and colour options.

Always on/Reels/Engaging/ReactNativeBlob.title: Street pickle tasting
Always on/Reels/Engaging/ReactNativeBlob.description: A creator offers pickles from a jar to strangers on the street, POV style. Low-budget sampling that lets real people do the talking.

Always on/Reels/Engaging/ReactNativeBlob.title: Shout for a free pizza
Always on/Reels/Engaging/ReactNativeBlob.description: A billboard asks people to shout 'I love pizza' and a pizza is delivered to whoever does. Street stunt that films real reactions.

Always on/Reels/Food/ReactNativeBlobUtil.title: Hands clear the table
Always on/Reels/Food/ReactNativeBlobUtil.description: Plates are named one by one, then hands grab everything at once and the table is empty. Quick menu roundup with a fun ending.

Always on/Reels/Food/ReactNativeBlobUtil.title: Ingredients drop into a salad
Always on/Reels/Food/ReactNativeBlobUtil.description: Top-down stop-motion where single ingredients roll and scatter onto linen until the finished salad lands. Clean way to show what goes into a dish.

Always on/Reels/Food/ReactNativeBlobUtil.title: Dancing asparagus price drop
Always on/Reels/Food/ReactNativeBlobUtil.description: Asparagus spears walk across a table past handwritten signs to land on the price. Cheap stop motion that turns a weekly special into something fun.

Always on/Reels/Food/ReactNativeBlobUtil.title: Moodboard sushi launch
Always on/Reels/Food/ReactNativeBlobUtil.description: Flat props on a terracotta backdrop cut to macro salmon textures, then the restaurant card lands. Works as a slick opening or menu teaser.

Always on/Reels/Food/ReactNativeBlobUtil.title: Single ingredient menu flash
Always on/Reels/Food/ReactNativeBlobUtil.description: Hard-lit fruit and chillies swap behind one bold headline while the new menu items sit as small type underneath. Simple, punchy way to announce a seasonal menu.

Always on/Reels/Food/ReactNativeBlobUtil.title: Fill-in-the-silhouettes flat lay
Always on/Reels/Food/ReactNativeBlobUtil.description: Blue silhouettes fill one by one with real items to build a summer essentials kit. Clean way to show a product range or bundle.

Always on/Reels/Food/ReactNativeBlobUtil.title: Fig dessert food porn
Always on/Reels/Food/ReactNativeBlobUtil.description: Slow syrup pours and macro close-ups of a fig parfait under one elegant title. Pure craving content for a seasonal dessert or ingredient.

Always on/Reels/Forgot Ingredients/Forgo.title: Forgot an ingredient panic
Always on/Reels/Forgot Ingredients/Forgo.description: She finishes baking, spots the baking powder still on the counter and freezes. A relatable kitchen fail that any food or grocery brand can recreate with its own product as the punchline.

Always on/Reels/Hooks/ReactNativeBlobUti.title: Caught on camera, budget joke
Always on/Reels/Hooks/ReactNativeBlobUti.description: A creator catches a guy staring, then cuts to a caption about still being in your budget. Hook-first skit with a sales twist at the end.

Always on/Reels/Hooks/ReactNativeBlobUti.title: Car rush transition hook
Always on/Reels/Hooks/ReactNativeBlobUti.description: She sets down a chair in the road, a car flies past and she is suddenly seated talking to camera. A jolt in the first seconds that earns the talking head.

Always on/Reels/Hooks/ReactNativeBlobUti.title: Desktop window menu tour
Always on/Reels/Hooks/ReactNativeBlobUti.description: A pop-up window frames each dish while a cursor clicks for the menu description. Desktop UI framing that explains food without a voiceover.

Always on/Reels/Lifestyle/Dinner plans.m.title: Dinner plans gone wrong
Always on/Reels/Lifestyle/Dinner plans.m.description: A short film where a cooking attempt ends in the sink and family saves the night with home food. Story-led ad that lands on warmth instead of product features.

Always on/Reels/Lifestyle/ReactNativeBlo.title: Day of the week outfits
Always on/Reels/Lifestyle/ReactNativeBlo.description: Split screens show a new outfit and treat for each day, with a top-down legs-up shot alongside. Repeatable weekly format for fashion or snack brands.

Always on/Reels/Lifestyle/ReactNativeBlo.title: Temperature countdown drink
Always on/Reels/Lifestyle/ReactNativeBlo.description: Degree counters drop from +35 to +21 as she sips the iced drink. Simple visual for showing how refreshing a product is.

Always on/Reels/Lifestyle/ReactNativeBlo.title: Wes Anderson day in the life
Always on/Reels/Lifestyle/ReactNativeBlo.description: Pastel, symmetrical shots with narrated captions follow a character through her day. Borrow the film style for a branded day in the life.

Always on/Reels/Lifestyle/ReactNativeBlo.title: Sponsor collage day out
Always on/Reels/Lifestyle/ReactNativeBlo.description: A creator moves through Roland Garros in a split collage with Perrier cans and bottles popping in. Event plus product placement edit with lots of layers.

Always on/Reels/Lifestyle/ReactNativeBlo.title: Calendar day planner
Always on/Reels/Lifestyle/ReactNativeBlo.description: A calendar widget plays each time slot as a mini video player. Turns a day in the life into a schedule viewers can follow.

Always on/Reels/Lifestyle/ReactNativeBlo.title: Photo dump in the share sheet
Always on/Reels/Lifestyle/ReactNativeBlo.description: An outfit shoot unfolds through desktop folders and an iOS share sheet of selected photos. Fun way to package a photo carousel as a reel.

Always on/Reels/POV/ReactNativeBlobUtilT.title: Bag-cam unboxing
Always on/Reels/POV/ReactNativeBlobUtilT.description: Shot from inside a gift bag looking up at the sky as hands pull out a 'Coming soon' card. Fresh POV angle for launches and teasers.

Always on/Reels/Pause to choose/Pause to.title: Pause to choose result
Always on/Reels/Pause to choose/Pause to.description: The landed frame of the pause game: a rosé paired with a dill pickle almond snack. Shows how each pause gives a clear product combo people can comment about.

Always on/Reels/Pause to choose/videofra.title: Pause game shuffle frame
Always on/Reels/Pause to choose/videofra.description: Another mid-shuffle frame from the pause-to-choose pairing reel, showing how the product images scroll fast in each window. Useful as a reference for the motion and pacing.

Always on/Reels/Pause to choose/videofra.title: Pause to choose pairing
Always on/Reels/Pause to choose/videofra.description: Mid-scroll frame of a 'pause to choose your pairing' reel, with wine and snack packs flicking past in two windows. Viewers try to pause on a combo, which keeps them watching.

Always on/Reels/Reveal/Hand cut through.title: Knife through the paper reveal
Always on/Reels/Reveal/Hand cut through.description: A blade slices through a red paper backdrop and a hand pushes through with the message written on the palm. Cheap, punchy way to drop a single line or launch.

Always on/Reels/Reveal/ReactNativeBlobUt.title: Lift doors open on the menu
Always on/Reels/Reveal/ReactNativeBlobUt.description: Lift doors open to reveal chefs and crates of fresh produce, then close on the restaurant logo and launch date. A neat teaser structure for openings and new menus.

Always on/Reels/Reveal/ReactNativeBlobUt.title: Phone screen pull-out
Always on/Reels/Reveal/ReactNativeBlobUt.description: A finger pinches the drink on a phone screen and the real product appears on the table above it. Clean product intro with name and flavour notes.

Always on/Reels/Reveal/ReactNativeBlobUt.title: Water spill hidden message
Always on/Reels/Reveal/ReactNativeBlobUt.description: Water poured on a surface makes a hidden message appear on paper. A tactile visual hook any brand can use to deliver one line.

Always on/Reels/This or That/videoframe_.title: This or that coffee pick
Always on/Reels/This or That/videoframe_.description: Black coffee at the top, a latte at the bottom, with 'this or that' in between. A simple two-option choice that pulls comments, easy to repeat with any pair of products.

Always on/Reels/Trends/ReactNativeBlobUt.title: Nothing without you frame
Always on/Reels/Trends/ReactNativeBlobUt.description: A paper frame reading 'This school is nothing without...' gets held up to each staff member in turn. Easy, warm format for staff or customer appreciation.

Always on/Reels/Trends/ReactNativeBlobUt.title: Boss wanted a video, I took photos
Always on/Reels/Trends/ReactNativeBlobUt.description: Stills of an event setup get dragged around with editor handles to fake motion. Self-aware joke that turns leftover photos into usable content.

Always on/Reels/UGC/ReactNativeBlobUtilT.title: Office voice note series
Always on/Reels/UGC/ReactNativeBlobUtilT.description: 'Lebo, quick one, Episode 2' plays a long voice note while she reacts at her desk. Episodic, local-feeling office comedy a brand can run as a recurring series.

Always on/Reels/UGC/v14044g50000d4gfdgvo.title: Making a video from the boss's voice note
Always on/Reels/UGC/v14044g50000d4gfdgvo.description: Staff play the manager's voice note and literally act out every instruction. Low-effort, staff-led content that shows team personality.

Always on/Reels/UGC/v1c044g50000d8g9c9no.title: Manager's voice note orders
Always on/Reels/UGC/v1c044g50000d8g9c9no.description: Staff act out a voice note from their absent manager, with the 'strict instructions' turning into a team ice cream break. Easy staff-led format for any store or restaurant.

Always on/Static/0509cefe7d4b9b1641110d3.title: Text field plans flat-lay
Always on/Static/0509cefe7d4b9b1641110d3.description: Cutout products float over an unmade bed around a selected iMessage text field reading 'my plans for the weekend'. Turns a product bundle into a relatable weekend plan.

Always on/Static/067c6bcd85d0a7923982128.title: Pantone drinks lineup
Always on/Static/067c6bcd85d0a7923982128.description: Three iced drinks shot from above sit on Pantone chips that match their colour. Clean and simple, and it works for any drinks menu or flavour range.

Always on/Static/1187fe6df15844f5e48e681.title: Annotated intro portrait
Always on/Static/1187fe6df15844f5e48e681.description: A designer stands in a doorway with a cutout outline, a big 'Hi, I'm Laura!' and arrows pointing to quick facts. Ideal for team intros, founder posts or a new ambassador.

Always on/Static/122b6944d8bc9991f532f3f.title: Chalk text top-down table
Always on/Static/122b6944d8bc9991f532f3f.description: Shot from directly above, a person reads at a round table with 'my favourite books of 2025' written around the edge in chalk-style type. A year-end favourites post with a strong layout.

Always on/Static/2e894c90cea0dc120898d27.title: Phone widget day planner
Always on/Static/2e894c90cea0dc120898d27.description: A cosy home scene is layered with a music player, a clock and a Notes checklist titled 'day plans'. A day-in-the-life story that feels personal and easy to copy.

Always on/Static/374b32a6c6db497394773fc.title: Maps route travel diary
Always on/Static/374b32a6c6db497394773fc.description: A rainy windscreen shot gets a Google Maps route overlaid on the glass and 'back home' text. A diary-style format for travel, road trip or delivery brands.

Always on/Static/39c94b044fcf6685d6c5e42.title: Tear-off flyer tabs
Always on/Static/39c94b044fcf6685d6c5e42.description: A street-flyer mockup with tear-off tabs offering romance tropes, one already pulled off. Works for any brand with a list of options, flavours or perks to 'take'.

Always on/Static/3badcc5333c3545ec204185.title: Four-dish menu quiz story
Always on/Static/3badcc5333c3545ec204185.description: A restaurant shows four breakfast plates around a numbered quiz sticker asking which one you'd choose. Gets votes and shows off the menu in one story.

Always on/Static/4032985f244cef0151f86df.title: Claw machine product grab
Always on/Static/4032985f244cef0151f86df.description: A 3D claw machine plucks one pack from a pile of flavours. Works as a 'pick your favourite' or giveaway visual for any range of packaged products.

Always on/Static/5a1a0603d03867bf7558130.title: Half-and-half split scene
Always on/Static/5a1a0603d03867bf7558130.description: One frame is split down the middle: a book in bed on one side, iced coffee on a table on the other, lined up so they read as one object. Handwritten labels tie the two moments together.

Always on/Static/5e643fd2609046ec69c9cf6.title: Pantone product range swatches
Always on/Static/5e643fd2609046ec69c9cf6.description: Six different croissants line up on Pantone chips, each matched to its own named shade. A neat way to show off a full range or flavour lineup.

Always on/Static/6003558179b7b3ccd02ec91.title: Emoji slider story template
Always on/Static/6003558179b7b3ccd02ec91.description: A template with a vertical strip of food photos next to an emoji slider. Drop in your own menu or range and let people slide to their favourite.

Always on/Static/6de1b5db952e1673590d93c.title: Highlighted text quote post
Always on/Static/6de1b5db952e1673590d93c.description: A quote is shown as selected iPhone text, complete with the Copy / Select All / Share menu, over a calm lifestyle photo. Makes a quote feel like something worth saving and sharing.

Always on/Static/722ad389e73f770e4c3ccd8.title: Ingredients pie chart
Always on/Static/722ad389e73f770e4c3ccd8.description: A cookie is cut like a pie chart, with the missing slices replaced by lemon, poppy seeds and an old recipe card. Shows what goes into a product in one clean visual.

Always on/Static/77d6a322e951bfed63f3ffb.title: Flowchart where product wins
Always on/Static/77d6a322e951bfed63f3ffb.description: A yes/no flowchart about solving problems loops every answer back to a glass of chai. A tongue-in-cheek format where all roads lead to your product.

Always on/Static/7f22fe76bf82d872d77bbd6.title: Emoji slider menu picker
Always on/Static/7f22fe76bf82d872d77bbd6.description: A stack of burgers sits next to a story emoji slider, inviting people to slide to their pick. Uses a native story feature to get taps on menu items.

Always on/Static/8b65c428131968705552bbc.title: Eye test colour joke
Always on/Static/8b65c428131968705552bbc.description: A red-tinted iced drink sits under an 'Eye test' headline: see yellow you're fine, see red you need coffee. A one-joke static that's easy to adapt to any product colour.

Always on/Static/91c73b7e0f59f7d471d6d7c.title: Numbered bubble quiz story
Always on/Static/91c73b7e0f59f7d471d6d7c.description: Four numbered circles show different breakfast options, linked to a quiz sticker asking which is your ideal. A simple vote format any menu or range can reuse.

Always on/Static/9c86872df95f4dbe4cc7b4d.title: Notes app to-do list
Always on/Static/9c86872df95f4dbe4cc7b4d.description: An iPhone Notes-style weekend to-do list slips the brand's serum and moisturiser in between brunch and beach plans. Product placement that reads like a personal note.

Always on/Static/Doodle-cookie.jpg.title: Doodle over product shot
Always on/Static/Doodle-cookie.jpg.description: A real cookie becomes a fresh-from-the-oven tray held by drawn oven mitts, with a sketched mouse eyeing it. Cheap to make and easy to repeat with any product.

Always on/Static/Pallete.jpg.title: Pantone chip product swap
Always on/Static/Pallete.jpg.description: A heap of heart-shaped churros sits on a Pantone-style swatch card with its own colour code. Any food or product brand can name a 'shade' after its hero item.

Always on/Static/a6b43efcab66ae530398672.title: Hand-drawn book annotations
Always on/Static/a6b43efcab66ae530398672.description: A hand holds a novel against a warm backdrop with handwritten notes and arrows pointing out the setting, vibe and rating. Works for any product that has 'features' worth labelling.

Always on/Static/a7e63885f40b92875a9d1e3.title: Folders and DM services post
Always on/Static/a7e63885f40b92875a9d1e3.description: Desktop folder icons float around a person reading a newspaper, each one named after a service, plus a DM bubble asking what's offered. Turns a services list into a scene.

Always on/Static/afa54520c7caa38cc9810ea.title: Search bar USP list
Always on/Static/afa54520c7caa38cc9810ea.description: A search bar types 'what makes our cookies special?' with autocomplete answers listing the selling points. A light way to share product benefits without a hard-sell layout.

Always on/Static/b731a27b32edd2e51288d22.title: Fake post breaking the frame
Always on/Static/b731a27b32edd2e51288d22.description: Chupa Chups pours lollipops out of a giant tub, through a fake Instagram post UI and into a mouth below. The post plays with the feed itself, which makes people stop scrolling.

Always on/Static/b9ed120633d40f6d5eb7135.title: Bracket annotation relatable joke
Always on/Static/b9ed120633d40f6d5eb7135.description: Brackets split a tub of ice cream into stages from 'just one bite' to 'might as well finish it'. The product shot doubles as a relatable joke about overindulging.

Always on/Static/c26787d334ff06fc3c8c309.title: Process to product split
Always on/Static/c26787d334ff06fc3c8c309.description: A close-up of frothing coffee sits above a clean, minimal shot of the finished iced coffee. Shows how it's made versus what you get, with no copy needed.

Always on/Static/cf56fd054e4ca2417c77c80.title: Monthly reads cafe flat-lay
Always on/Static/cf56fd054e4ca2417c77c80.description: A top-down cafe table shot with a book cover dropped in the middle and 'What I read in August' text. An easy monthly series for book, cafe or lifestyle accounts.

Always on/Static/e8bb606c6e824cae25ba800.title: Topping poll story
Always on/Static/e8bb606c6e824cae25ba800.description: Quaker surrounds a 'how do you top it?' poll with four rice cakes, each with a different topping. Shows the product's range while getting the audience to vote.

Always on/Static/f34ef811756601dbac4ff89.title: Food origin quiz story
Always on/Static/f34ef811756601dbac4ff89.description: A 9GAG story asks where Swedish meatballs come from, using a multiple-choice quiz sticker over the dish. Food trivia gets quick taps and works for any brand with a story behind its product.

Always on/Static/f76ed2b755054f40c249487.title: Before and after coffee meme
